title: Ecocem invests €12m in Moerdijk slag cement grinding plant
summary: Ecocem invests €12m in Moerdijk slag cement grinding plant
body_markdown:
**Netherlands:** On 6 November 2026, Ecocem announced its expansion of low-carbon cement solutions to meet evolving customer needs and help accelerate the decarbonisation of concrete. The company is investing €12m in its Moerdijk operations, adding new silo capacity, laboratory facilities and advanced blending technology. Construction is underway, with the new blending installation expected to be completed by mid-2027.


Ecocem will also introduce ECO2CEM III in 2027, a CEM III blend developed specifically for the precast concrete industry. Alongside this, **** Ecocem is bringing its ACT technology to the Benelux market. ACT offers a scalable solution to rapidly decarbonise the cement and concrete industry. Ecocem expects to begin supplying ACT to customers from its new Dunkirk facility in France in the first quarter of 2027.


Paul Roos, Managing Director, said “With ACT, we are taking a fundamentally new step towards scalable low-carbon cement. Both developments share the same objective: helping our customers reduce CO₂ emissions with solutions that meet the practical requirements of our industry in terms of performance, availability and cost.”
